key.name: meme-folders
key.description: Folders scanned recursively for JPG, JPEG, and PNG meme images.

key.name: online-search-enabled
key.description: Whether Ctrl+Enter searches configured online meme providers.

key.name: online-provider
key.description: Online meme provider to use. Supported values are imgflip and giphy.

key.name: giphy-api-key
key.description: GIPHY API key used for online GIF search.

key.name: online-result-limit
key.description: Maximum number of online results to show.

key.name: giphy-rating
key.description: Maximum GIPHY content rating to request. Supported values are g, pg, pg-13, and r.
